caption: The drawing depicts a tankard with a large, angular handle positioned to the right side. The tankard is divided into vertical sections, with some sections displaying intricate floral and leaf patterns while others appear shaded. The object is rendered in pencil or graphite on a beige, lightly textured background, resulting in a grayscale appearance. Beneath the tankard, there is a horizontal strip that illustrates a repeating decorative border featuring circular and floral motifs, possibly intended to represent the design around the base of the tankard. An arrow links this decorative strip to the base of the tankard. The artist’s name, "JOHN FISK.", is written in uppercase letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Silver Mug
